AR332
Children in the Ancient World
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
investigates the raising, nurturing and treatment of children in the Ancient Mediterranean World between c. 4000 BCE and 400 CE.
Students
use art, archaeological and literary evidence to analyze how gender, age, disease, care, religion, politics etc., shaped the childhoods of ancient children.
Additional Course Information
Exclusions
CL332, NE332.
